# BitBuyBoss

> Marketplace for premium digital products and professional services, paid with Bitcoin. No KYC, instant delivery, total privacy.

BitBuyBoss is a Bitcoin-native e-commerce platform offering digital products and services with on-chain BTC payments, automated order fulfillment, and instant digital delivery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the BitBuyBoss platform and value proposition.
- [Services](/services): Browse the catalog of digital products and services available for Bitcoin.
- [Sign In / Sign Up](/auth): Create an account or sign in.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How user data is collected, stored, and protected.
